mapper.sql: select p.plot_id, p.enterprise_id, e.enterprise_name, r.region_name, p.plot_name, p.plot_code, p.area_ha, p.soil_type, p.elevation_m, p.gps_coordinates, p.planted_variety, p.vine_age, p.status, p.del_flag, p.remark, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time from trace_vineyard_plot p left join trace_enterprise e on e.enterprise_id = p.enterprise_id left join trace_region r on r.region_id = e.region_id
mapper.select: select count(1) from trace_batch where plot_id = #{plotId} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
